/us/bonus-tax-calculator.html: Quick answer (2026): Bonuses are usually withheld at a flat 22% federal rate (37% on supplemental pay above $1 million in the year), plus 6.2% Social Security up to $184,500 of wages and 1.45% Medicare. On a $10,000 bonus with no state tax you take home about $7,035.
/us/pmi-calculator.html: Quick answer: PMI typically costs 0.3%–1.0% of the loan a year — about $30–$70 a month per $100,000 borrowed (Freddie Mac). On a $300,000 loan at 0.6% that is $150 a month. You can ask to cancel it at 80% loan-to-value, and it ends automatically at 78%.
/us/fire-calculator.html: Quick answer: Your FIRE number is 25 × your yearly spending at a 4% withdrawal rate — $1.25 million for $50,000 a year. Starting from zero at a 5% real return, saving 25% of take-home pay takes about 32 years; saving 50% takes about 17 years.
/us/benefits/ssi-benefit.html: Quick answer (2027): The federal SSI payment is $1,029 a month for an individual and $1,544 for a couple, after the 3.6% COLA. The first payment at the new rate is paid on December 31, 2026. Countable income reduces it after the $20 and $65 exclusions.
/uk/mortgage-affordability-calculator.ht: Quick answer: Most UK lenders lend about 4–4.5 times gross household income, some up to 5.5×, minus the effect of your debts. On £70,000 that is roughly £280,000–£315,000; £900 a month repays about £163,600 over 25 years at 4.4%.
/uk/pcp-car-finance-calculator.html: Quick answer: A PCP payment covers the car's expected depreciation plus interest on the whole amount, leaving a final balloon (GMFV). A £28,000 car with £3,000 down, an £11,000 balloon at 8.9% APR over 48 months costs about £424 a month, against £617 on HP. You can hand it back once you've paid half the total amount payable.
/uk/credit-card-repayment-calculator.htm: Quick answer: £3,500 at 24.9% APR takes 31 months to clear at £150 a month (about £1,142 interest) and 17 months at £250 a month. Paying only the minimum can take well over a decade.
/uk/pension-tax-relief-calculator.html: Quick answer (2026/27): Pension contributions get relief at your top income tax rate: 20% basic (added automatically), 40% higher and 45% additional (extra claimed via Self Assessment or HMRC). Between £100,000 and £125,140 the effective relief is 60% because you win back your personal allowance.
/uk/salary-to-hourly-calculator.html: Quick answer: Hourly rate = salary ÷ (weekly hours × 52). £30,000 a year is £15.38 an hour at 37.5 hours a week. The National Living Wage is £12.71 from April 2026 and rises to £13.21 from April 2027.
/uk/pro-rata-salary-calculator.html: Quick answer: Pro rata salary = full-time salary × your hours ÷ full-time hours. £36,000 pro rata for 22.5 of 37.5 hours is £21,600 a year (£1,800 a month), at the same hourly rate. Holiday is 5.6 weeks pro rata — 16.8 days for 3 days a week.
/ca/salary-after-tax-calculator.html: Quick answer (2026): A $75,000 salary in Ontario leaves about $56,926 a year ($4,744 a month) after federal and Ontario tax, CPP/CPP2 and EI. $100,000 leaves about $74,206 in Ontario, $75,373 in BC, $74,459 in Alberta and $69,585 in Quebec.
/ca/capital-gains-tax-calculator.html: Quick answer (2026): Only 50% of a capital gain is taxable in Canada. With $80,000 of other income in Ontario, a $20,000 gain costs about $2,965 in tax (14.8% of the gain); the top effective rate is about 26.8%.
/es/calculadora-gasto-gasolina.html: Respuesta rápida: Coste = km × consumo (L/100 km) ÷ 100 × precio por litro. Un viaje de 500 km con 6 L/100 km y gasolina a 1,79 €/L cuesta unos 53,70 €. Precio medio en España (12/10/2026): 1,790 €/L gasolina 95 y 1,889 €/L diésel.
/au/fuel-cost-calculator.html: Quick answer: Fuel cost = km × L/100 km ÷ 100 × price per litre. A 500 km trip at 7 L/100 km and $2.34/L costs about $81.90. National averages around 7 November 2026: unleaded about 234.3 c/L, diesel about 278 c/L.
/zh/savings-goal-calculator.html: 快速答案：3 年存 10 万元，按年利率 1.25% 按月复利，每月约需存 2,727 元（不计利息为 2,778 元）。2026 年四大行三年期定期利率为 1.25%，一年期 0.95%。
/tw/labor-pension/labor-pension-account-: 快速答案：2026 年勞退月提繳工資最高 150,000 元（雇主 6% 每月最多 9,000 元），60 歲可請領。30 歲起、月提繳工資 60,800 元、年收益 3% 試算，60 歲只有雇主 6% 約 212.6 萬元，加上自提 6% 約 425.2 萬元。新制勞退基金 2025 年收益率 15.60%。
/uk/net-worth-calculator.html: Quick answer: net worth = everything you own minus everything you owe. The latest ONS figures (April 2020 – March 2022) put median household wealth in Great Britain at £293,700; the top 10% start at £1,200,500. With the default figures above, net worth is £102,400.
/br/calculadora-nota-enem-sisu.html: Resposta rápida: média do Sisu = soma de (nota × peso) ÷ soma dos pesos. Notas 640, 650, 600, 700 e 820 com pesos 1, 1, 2, 3 e 2 dão 692,22. O resultado do Enem 2026 sai em 18 de janeiro de 2027, segundo o Inep.
/uk/emergency-fund-calculator.html: Quick answer: MoneyHelper suggests keeping three to six months of essential outgoings in an instant-access account. With essentials of £2,000 a month that is £6,000–£12,000; savings are FSCS-protected up to £120,000 per person per authorised firm (2026).
/es/calculadora-consumo-electrico.html: Respuesta rápida: kWh = vatios ÷ 1.000 × horas. Un aparato de 1.000 W usado 3 horas al día gasta 90 kWh al mes: 13,50 € a 0,15 €/kWh. En 2026 la luz lleva el impuesto eléctrico (5,11269632 % ordinario) y el IVA (21 %, con rebajas temporales al 10 %).
/us/benefits/free-school-meals.html: Quick answer: for July 2026 – June 2027, a family of 4 qualifies for free school meals with income up to $42,900 a year ($3,575 a month) and for reduced-price meals up to $61,050 ($5,088 a month) in the 48 states and DC. Reduced-price lunch costs no more than 40¢.
/au/hourly-to-salary-calculator.html: Quick answer: annual salary = hourly rate × 38 hours × 52 weeks. $35 an hour is $69,160 a year ($2,660 a fortnight), about $56,509 after 2026-27 tax and Medicare. The national minimum wage from 1 July 2026 is $26.44 an hour ($1,004.90 a week).
/es/calculadora-nota-pau.html: Respuesta rápida: nota de acceso = 0,6 × Bachillerato + 0,4 × prueba (prueba ≥ 4 y resultado ≥ 5); nota de admisión = acceso + las dos mejores materias × 0,1 o 0,2, hasta 14. Con 8,2 y 7,1 la nota de acceso es 7,76. En Andalucía la PAU 2027 ordinaria es el 1, 2 y 3 de junio.
